title: 1 John Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 1 John 2: the Counselor with the Father, keeping his commandments, loving or hating a brother, and the many antichrists.

questions.text: Whom does the letter say we have as a Counselor with the Father if anyone sins?
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:1 says that if anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

questions.text: According to the letter, how do we know that we know him?
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:3 says this is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

answers.text: If we give away our goods

questions.text: What does the letter call someone who says "I know him" but does not keep his commandments?
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:4 says that such a person is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

questions.text: What does the letter say about the one who claims to be in the light but hates his brother?
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:9 says that he who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

answers.text: He walks in the true light
He has overcome the evil one
He will be called a child of the Father
He is in the darkness even until now

questions.text: Why does the one who hates his brother not know where he is going?
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:11 says he walks in the darkness and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

answers.text: The darkness has blinded his eyes
He has no teacher to guide him
He has lost the written word

questions.text: Which three things does the letter say are in the world?
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:16 says that all that is in the world - the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life - is not the Father's but the world's.

answers.text: Gold, silver and precious stones from the nations
The lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life
Hunger, thirst and the weariness of the body
Fear, doubt and anger in the heart of man

questions.text: What does the letter say happens to the one who does God's will?
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:17 says the world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God's will remains forever.

answers.text: He passes away with the world

questions.text: By what does the letter say they know that it is the final hour?
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:18 says that even now many antichrists have arisen, and by this they know that it is the final hour.

questions.text: Whom does the letter call the liar and the Antichrist?
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:22 asks who the liar is but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ, and calls him the Antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.

answers.text: He who refuses to be taught
He who denies that Jesus is the Christ

questions.text: What is the promise that he promised us, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 2:25 says that this is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
